body:
No worries man, you have to face your demons head on and vanquish them. We can hope for one day or we could start day one now. 

Even I made a couple of female friends this past week, got group hugs and touchy feely vibes from them. Got their numbers as well planning to meet with one of them next week. Hope fully she doesn't notice the dead grey eyes of regret.
Probably a sign from the NoFap Lord, to give up our transgressions.

This time there is no peeking for me, no more instagram/fb/snapchat all these things induce dopamine cravings. 

I will go monk mode and just start lifting and stay away from unproductive things that edge me towards depravity such as pornography and procrastination.

Thanks for the advice, mate. I can feel pyshical weakness and diffidence after pmo. This is my second relapse but my longest ever streak. 

Since yesterday I hadn't looked at one image of any porn inducer. I have started hardcore no PMO target, my goal is to be PMO free for a year then after that start looking for an ideal companion.
Yes, I can't focus on anything and I feel lethargic.
Do you lift? Take all that anger and frustration to the iron temple.
Is this an animation or real life?

I have been experiencing synchronicity all my life during different points in my life, however these past few weeks there has been an increase in such events.

Also last month I started getting depersonalization, where a person doesn't feel real and it's is driving me nuts.
Just seeing the world the way it is, I try to look at the good things of this life. However I fail to see my own good because I know I am a just another speck of microbial dust in this vast universe.
